Hardware and Code
=================


Key Goals
---------


Options
-------
.. _hwcodeOptions:

The following table offers some simple
comparissons of the different platforms...

.. table:: Comparisson

    ================= ================ ========= =============
    Platform          Self-contained?  Cost      Flexibility
    ================= ================ ========= =============
    Raspberri Pi      No                $30         Limitless
    Lego Mindstorms     Yes             $350        Medium
    ================= ================ ========= =============

.. list-table:: Comparisson (with list-table directive)
   :widths: 20 10 10 15 20
   :header-rows: 1
   :class: tight-table

   * - Platform
     - Self-contained?
     - Cost
     - Flexibility
     - Description
   * - Raspberry Pi
     - No
     - $30
     - Limitless
     - Mini computer board with GPIO pins for interfacing and experimentation
   * - Lego Mindstorms
     - Yes
     - $350
     - Medium
     - Lego robotic system with motors and sensors. Build a robot, then have fun.

.. csv-table:: Comparisson (with csv-table directive)
   :header: Platform,Self-contained?,Cost,Flexibility
   :widths: 15 10 30 30

    Raspberry Pi,No,$30,Limitless
    Lego Mindstorms,Yes,$350,Medium

Raspberry Pi (Family)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Here is what a Raspberry Pi 2 and
a Sense HAT look like:

.. image:: /images/PiAndSenseHAT.png

With these, you can do cool things
like program your own version
of Connect-4 -- you will need to
consider how to check for a win
by evaluating options as shown in
the diagram below:

.. image:: Connect4-logic.jpg
